title: death
summary: MSUI covers the current derived death state machine and wire-fed stores: unreleased/ghost/alive edges, release timing, corpse query and own-corpse GUID, 40-yard recovery/instance gating, strict resurrect offer variants and expiry, the 5.5556-yard two-step spirit-healer confirmation, durability warnings, and map/minimap corpse consumers.

openItems.text: MSG_CORPSE_QUERY is never sent/consumed: the corpse location is known only once the corpse OBJECT streams into range, so there is no corpse position for the run back (no map/minimap corpse marker, no dungeon-entrance stand-in for a corpse inside an instance).
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: ghost/login transitions query the corpse, strict found/not-found responses feed map/minimap markers and the dungeon-entrance-aware 40-yard range gate.

openItems.text: SMSG_SPIRIT_HEALER_CONFIRM unhandled: no XP-loss/durability confirm two-step before spirit-healer resurrection - activation is sent directly without the reference's CONFIRM_XP_LOSS popup.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: the healer confirm GUID opens the exact sickness/no-sickness two-stage penalty popup, closes out of range, and only final Accept sends activation.
